guidance.heading: Guidance
section: In its supplemental presentation materials, “Third Quarter 2026 Financial Review and Analysis,” the company provides a list of factors that it believes will contribute to its financial results. Based on the factors listed and other assumptions, the company expects full year 2026 reported EPS of $9.45 to $9.59.
Excluding an estimated $0.65 impact of restructuring charges and other items, the company expects full year 2026 adjusted EPS of $10.10 to $10.24.

For more details on the company’s results, see the financial schedules accompanying this news release, as well as the supplemental presentation materials, “Third Quarter 2026 Financial Review and Analysis,” posted on the company’s website at www.investors.averydennison.com, and furnished to the SEC on Form 8-K.
Throughout this release and the supplemental presentation materials, amounts on a per share basis reflect fully diluted shares outstanding.
